story.title: Houthi Rebels Claim Responsibility for Attacks on Saudi Oil Facilities in Riyadh
story.summary: Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for attacks on facilities belonging to Aramco, the world's largest oil company, in Riyadh. Reports from residents indicated flames and smoke rising from an oil facility on the outskirts of the Saudi capital. The Houthis have also accused Saudi Arabia of conducting numerous strikes on Sanaa, warning of continued retaliation against any escalation.

timeline_highlights.title: Investigation Launched into Low-Flying Jets Over Cape Town Stadium
timeline_highlights.summary: South African aviation authorities are investigating a low-altitude flyover by two Airlink passenger jets over DHL Stadium in Cape Town. The incident occurred before a rugby match between the Springboks and the All Blacks and has raised safety concerns following a viral video showing the jets barely clearing the stadium.

timeline_highlights.summary: Flydubai Captain Smit Machchhar recounted a traumatic incident where he was attacked by his co-pilot during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Despite being wounded, he stated that he felt compelled to protect the passengers on board. The attack occurred earlier this week, raising serious concerns about cockpit safety.

timeline_highlights.title: Pilot Recalls Heroic Actions During Flydubai Cockpit Attack
timeline_highlights.summary: Capt. Smit Machchhar, recovering in a hospital, described his harrowing experience during an attack on a Flydubai flight. He recounted how he fought to regain control of the cockpit, realizing that if he did not act, the passengers' lives were at risk. His actions, which included opening the cockpit door to allow passengers to assist, have led to him being hailed as a hero.

related_stories.title: Bosnia Holds Elections Amid Ethnic Tensions and Pro-Russian Political Influence
related_stories.summary: Bosnia is conducting elections where approximately 3.4 million voters are selecting members for the multi-ethnic presidency, national Parliament lawmakers, and heads of institutions for the country's two entities. The elections are marked by the significant presence of a pro-Russian politician and ongoing ethnic tensions, alongside concerns regarding the stalled European Union membership bid.

related_stories.title: Cornell President Responds to Alleged Gang Rape Incident at Fraternity
related_stories.summary: Cornell University's president, Michael Kotlikoff, described the allegations of a gang rape involving a student at a fraternity house as 'deeply disturbing.' In a recent video statement, he emphasized the need for the university to improve its response to such incidents. The allegations have led to increased scrutiny of the university's handling of sexual assault cases, with the accuser, identified as Jane Doe, suing the university and several former students.

related_stories.title: Understanding the Kelvin Wave Impacting Sea Levels on the West Coast
related_stories.summary: A Kelvin wave is currently affecting sea levels along the West Coast, characterized by bulges of water that raise sea levels as they travel. Unlike tsunamis, these waves do not crash onto the shore but rather resemble water sloshing in a bathtub. This phenomenon is significant for coastal areas as it can lead to temporary increases in sea level.

related_stories.title: Brazilians Begin Voting in Polarized Presidential Election
related_stories.summary: Voting has commenced in Brazil's 2026 presidential election, featuring incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva against Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The election is marked by a deeply polarized atmosphere, with polls indicating a tight race that may lead to a runoff. Approximately 160 million voters are also selecting lawmakers, senators, and governors in this significant electoral event.
